ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $AD\perp BC$ at point D, and point E is on side $AB$, with $EF\parallel AC$ intersecting the extension of $AD$ at point F. If $\angle C=40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AEF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the problem,\\
$\because AB=AC$,\\
$\angle C=40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle B=\angle C=40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC=180^\circ-\angle B-\angle C=100^\circ$,\\
$\because EF\parallel AC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC+\angle AEF=180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AEF=\boxed{80^\circ}$.
